utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Morning. Can everyone hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. The heating in the portakabin, honestly—it's either Arctic or tropical. No middle setting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: You've still got your coat on, though.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Insurance, that is. Don't trust it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Like the defending in the football last night. Absolutely no confidence in any of it.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: We doing football analysis or a stand-up, then?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: All right, all right. Tough audience this morning.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, was that me crackling? I've changed headsets.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: You're clear now. Bit loud, if anything.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right. Priya Raman and Jamie Brennan aren't with us today. Sarah, how was overnight?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, so, finished the repair on the pump in the pit last night. That's all sorted.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lovely. Not the nicest spot to spend your evening.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No. Definitely not getting a five-star review.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Okay, quick round on the bits from yesterday, then today's work.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Han asked me to pass on where she's got to with the near-miss write-up. She's had a first look, nothing major so far; she's partway through it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Cheers. Wasn't sure I'd get this headset working in time.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And Whitty asked me to say the function test on the HV board is all done.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Mine—the permit to work and isolation for the GT1 fuel valve—that's sorted. All fine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Haley asked me to flag the site visit with the contractor. Can't go ahead because the parts haven't turned up.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah. Frustrating, that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, onto what we need to agree today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Davey, can you chase the purchase order for the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock this morning, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah—just the purchase order you're after, not chasing a delivery date as well?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Just the purchase order, yeah.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Okay, I'll chase that this morning, whenever I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: This morning's going to disappear quickly, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Usually does. There's the production downtime slot to pin down as well.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I'll schedule downtime for the little water valve on two with production, at half two. Normal priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Reidy. Better having an actual slot than trying to squeeze it in.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: The famous five-minute stop that isn't five minutes.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly. None of that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'll update the risk assessment for work on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve, due tomorrow at 9:30. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Agreed, Davey. That risk assessment comes first.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll put that ahead of the other bits.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Get the paperwork right before everyone gets carried away, basically.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Absolutely. No sense rushing past that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Anything else on your side, then?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the long belt by 11am. Not an emergency but don't let it slip—that's how I'm treating it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: The sensors as well, not just pull the jam out and call it good?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, both. Clear it and check the sensors, by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, David Whitfield for that one. Your full name's finally appeared properly on Teams.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sounds like I'm being called into the head's office.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Only if he uses your middle name.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—you're happy with that order of work?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah. Risk assessment first, and the belt by 11am. The purchase-order chase fits round those this morning.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Okay, that works.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Only other thing from me: I heard a slight rattle from the counterbalances. Nothing to action yet, just an observation.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Hard to hear yourself think round there sometimes.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Mm. It was only slight.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right. Anything else anyone needs in the room before we break?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nothing else from me.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No, that's me. Back to the portakabin climate lottery.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: All good here.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Lovely. Thanks, everyone. Catch you on the floor.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Cheers, all.
